prices.refusal_reason: "pro" is an API plan string, not a vendor tier name. OpenAI publishes Pro 100 ($100), Pro 200 ($200) and Pro 500 ($500); the API plan string does not establish which an account holds, so this key cannot carry one price. The tier rows are openai/pro_100, openai/pro_200 and openai/pro_500; the account's tier is a fact about the account.

quota_value.basis: List-price value of in-scope tokens divided by (weekly-window quota points used x fee per point), fee per point = monthly price x 7/30 / 100. Codex weekly ('primary') window, two Pro 200 accounts pooled; the Pro 100 account is measured separately and is not included. Daily rows 2026-10-27..11-01, each covering the trailing 7 days: the six days that pass astrocyte's routing-eligibility checks. Rows from 11-02 on are excluded, because both quota counters sat at 100% for 36-69% of the time, and a saturated counter hides real usage. Reads 1-2% high, because usage between the last reading and a reset is lost.
